title: Fuel Link
description: Shares the fuel left (litres) and the range with your own phone over your tailnet, read-only, for the Shell diesel page

config._comment: port: the read-only JSON at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/fuel, on this head unit only; 'tailscale serve' publishes it to your tailnet over HTTPS. allowOrigin: the page allowed to read it from a browser.
